integrity: The full finite 400-plane orbit and Galois census is supported by an exact standalone standard-library checker. Claims of exhaustive literature priority and external independent verification are not made.
limitations: The claim is for the explicitly embedded Barth–Bauer quartic over Q and for cutting planes only; the fields of the individual complementary conics can be larger. The global enumeration of geometric conics and group matrices are accepted published premises, not reproduced.
title: Biquadratic splitting fields for the 400 conic-pair planes on the Barth–Bauer quartic
